image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) against a white background. The armor features a raised central ridge, curved anatomical contours for the chest and abdomen, and rolled edges at the armholes and neck. A leather strap with a metal buckle is visible on the right side, connecting the front plate to the back. The surface shows realistic reflections and minor discoloration/oxidation spots.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar objects like plastrons or generic metal sheets.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, texture consistency, and check for subtle AI-generation artifacts in the polish.
To verify the structural integrity of the rolled edges and ensure no melting or fusion artifacts at the boundaries.
To validate the 3D depth of the central ridge and the convexity of the chest plate.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflection patterns on the metal surface; AI often generates inconsistent or 'muddy' reflections on curved metallic objects. Verify if the strap on the right side connects logically to the plate or if it appears fused. Check if the central ridge maintains consistent width and depth.
